scientific_integrity: The exact radical and all-size uniqueness are derived from the root-orbit resultant and elementary global angular optimization. Finite numerical checks are corroboration, not a proof of global optimality or originality.
scientific_limitations: The determinant optimization is restricted to three fixed-size regular cyclic orbits, with two equal inner radii and one fixed outer orbit. It does not optimize nodewise angles, radii, smallest singular value, or spectral condition number; a full earlier interpolation manuscript was inaccessible.
title: Radius-dependent staggering for optimal three-orbit Hardy interpolation determinants
